description: MTA Subway Hot Car Work Orders: Beginning 2015 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset contains records of NYCT subway hot car work orders, aggregated monthly by car, car class, and service line. For each grouping it includes the fleet size for that car class, the car's years in service, and the total number of work orders filed. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are subway service, work orders, subway cars, nyct, maintenance. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
